title: Pipe photo gallery with Previous / Next and sidebar
description:
View Photos opens a custom gallery popup for the pipe run: a large photo stage, Previous / Next controls, and a scrollable sidebar of thumbnails to jump quickly. Exit (or Escape) closes the gallery. Arrow keys also move between photos. Shaft photo marks open the same gallery on that photo.

Who is affected: PipeShare users reviewing pipe inspections on the private server, and on SaaS after Push.
changeLog: View Photos opens a custom gallery popup with Exit.
Previous / Next buttons and arrow keys step through run photos.
Scrollable sidebar thumbnails jump to any photo in the run.
